meta.title: My First NYC Snowstorm. (James Dant x Horse & Anchor Review Tote Bag Review)
meta.description:
The best vintage upcycled tote bag. There I SAID IT I SAID IT. You had me at raw selvedge denim lining. Also I'm getting an L.L. Bean tote bag soon...I think I have an issue. I love totes.

Don't forget to subscribe/follow me on instagram!
@8thWeekday 

Great job Lawrence! And a special shout out to James Dant purveyors for putting me onto Horse & Anchor.

New York City! The city where dreams are made and or destroyed! My friend made fun of me for always wanting to go to NYC but I did and it's lovely. So yeah basically I just wanted around central park for a few, then went to Times Square and some guy screamed at me that he was going to get me. It's been a while since that day and he still hasn't gotten me though so I'm feeling pretty good about it.

Outfit in the thumbnail:
Levi's Denim Jacket Type III 
A.P.C light wash selvedge jeans
Blundstones
